name: 28792 · Hendersonvlle, NC
findings: ZIP 28792 (Hendersonvlle) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28792 (Hendersonvlle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
